description.ja: 『ヤマトよ永遠に REBEL3199』に登場する、宇宙戦艦ヤマトの姉妹艦「銀河」が豊富な付属品を同梱して、1/1000スケールで商品化！
description.en: Space Battleship Yamato's sister ship "Ginga " that appears in " Yamato Forever REBEL 3199" is commercialized in 1/1000 Scale with a rich variety of accessories!

description.ja: ■1/1000スケールで細部ディテール、モールドを再現したディスプレイモデル。
description.en: • A display model that reproduces fine details and molds in 1/1000 scale.

description.ja: ■エフェクトパーツが付属し、主砲の発射を再現。
description.en: • Effect parts are included to reproduce the firing of the main gun.

description.ja: ■艦橋ドームパーツは色再現用のほか、別売りのLEDユニットを使用する際に使える無色のクリアパーツが付属。
description.en: • In addition to the bridge dome parts for color reproduction, colorless clear parts that can be used when using the separately sold LED unit are also included.

description.ja: ■付属のディスプレイスタンドには艦載機が取り付け可能。
description.en: • A carrier-based aircraft can be attached to the included display stand.

description.ja: ■各種マーキングを収録した水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: • Water transfer decals containing various markings are included.

accessories.ja: コスモゼロミサイル搭載機×1
accessories.en: Cosmo Zero missile equipped machine x 1
Cosmo Tiger II three seats x 2

accessories.ja: 主砲エフェクト(大、中、小)×各3
accessories.en: Main gun effects (large, medium, small) x 3 each
